data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 165,799k (2016 - GBP 121,917k) is a deterioration of GBP 11,547k (2016 - deterioration of GBP 6,859k) to the claims reserves established at the prior year end, principally due to natural catastrophes (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, Maria, Mexico Earthquake and Californian Wildfires) and adverse attritional development in prior year reserves on the Property and Marine classes. Losses were partially offset by an improvement on the Liability class driven by the release of the 2016 Ogden margin as well as favourable claims development in the year. The year closed at a loss of GBP 16,247k following a calendar year loss of GBP 10,113k and a brought-forward retained loss after 24 months of GBP 6,134k. the distribution of the closing profit on the 2014 year of account of GBP 25,887k.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced mixed prior year development in 2017. There was a net deterioration of GBP 11.547m to claims reserves from prior years, primarily driven by natural catastrophe events such as Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, Maria, Mexico earthquakes, and Californian Wildfires, as well as adverse attritional development on Property and Marine classes. This was partially offset by a release from the 2016 Ogden margin and favourable claims development in the Liability class. Additionally, the 2014 year of account closed with a profit distribution of GBP 25.887m (a release), while the 2015 year of account closed with a loss of GBP 16.247m (a strengthening).
